* Name: Emperor

== Biography ==

The Emperor rules from a tin castle whose furniture, floors, and walls are all made of brightly polished tin, a detail he takes pride in showing visitors. He dresses only in tin himself and offers hospitality to guests, inviting them to prepare for dinner served in his grand tin dining-hall.
